title: Ops asset edit source omits the existing asset directory
expected: The asset edit path's id_sources names GET /ops/assets -> asset_id for a staff member opening an asset to update directly.
actual: The bundle names POST /ops/work-orders/{wo_id}/assign as its sole asset_id source. That is a separate write and cannot serve as a prerequisite to edit every existing asset. The screen already has GET /ops/assets, which returns asset_id and row_version.
steps: As demo.ops, read GET /ops/assets. Compare its response fields with the only asset_id source in the ops_console bundle for PUT /ops/assets/{asset_id}.
evidence: GET /ops/assets returned 200 and three directory entries with asset_id and row_version, request_id 9b4f5304dfea49889b9e81f73881ed3a. Read only. No assignment or update was required. DEV 2026-11-09T17:10:47.430848+00:00.
